def check(x, y, l2, l0, m, sol):
    p = x.shape[1]
    w = np.array(sol['weights'])
    f = 0.5 * np.sum((x @ w - y) ** 2) + 0.5 * l2 * (w @ w) + l0 * np.count_nonzero(abs(w) > 1e-08)
    assert np.max(abs(w)) <= m and abs(f - sol['objective']) < 1e-08
    ids = np.arange(1 << p, dtype=np.int64)
    seen = np.zeros(len(ids), dtype=np.uint8)
    bits = 1 << np.arange(p)
    g = x.T @ x
    slack = 0
    for leaf in sol['subcube_leaves']:
        assert all((type(v) is bool for name in ['fixed_active', 'fixed_zero'] for v in leaf[name]))
        a = np.array(leaf['fixed_active'])
        z = np.array(leaf['fixed_zero'])
        assert not (a & z).any()
        seen[ids & bits @ (a | z) == bits @ a] += 1
        c = np.array(leaf['minorant_center'])
        d = np.array(leaf['minorant_diagonal'])
        assert min(d) >= 0 and np.linalg.eigvalsh(g - np.diag(d))[0] >= -1e-09
        r = y - x @ c
        h = x.T @ r
        v = h + d * c
        k = d + l2
        u = np.clip(np.divide(v, k, out=m * np.sign(v), where=k > 0), -m, m)
        on = l0 + 0.5 * k * u * u - v * u
        lb = 0.5 * (r @ r) + h @ c + 0.5 * np.dot(d, c * c) + on[a].sum() + np.minimum(on[~(a | z)], 0).sum()
        slack = max(slack, leaf['lb'] - lb)
    assert np.all(seen == 1) and slack <= 1e-09
    return (f - sol['certified_lower_bound'], len(sol['subcube_leaves']))
